text:
Sam W: Morning — quick async check. Onboarded `mistral-ops-14b-q2` to staging yesterday. Ran evals on promptset `legal-clauses-50` and saw a ~7% drop vs baseline. Need eyes on whether quant profile or tokenizer mismatch.
Aisha K: ack. Can you paste the eval summary? :mag_right:
Sam W: pasted small snippet:
```
model: mistral-ops-14b-q2
profile: int8-v2
promptset: legal-clauses-50
baseline: 0.87 -> new: 0.81 (7.1% drop)
failure modes: truncated clauses, hallucinated additions
```
Ravi P: that smells like tokenization or eos handling during kv-cache warmup. Did you test with `--disable-prefix-cache`?
Sam W: yes, tried `--disable-prefix-cache`, no change. Also tried `tokenize --check` — no obvious mismatch. I'm leaning to quantization scale shifts.
Luca G: FYI I pushed a micro-fix to quantization tables yesterday — could be related. Which quant preset did you use? `qconfig=range-asymmetric`?
Sam W: int8-v2 / range-asymmetric. Also observed increased perplexity on a few examples.
Aisha K: Can we run the local-replay with `--seed=42 --kv-warmup=5` and attach logs? I can triage if you drop the eval artifacts in s3.
Sam W: uploading now to s3://redwood-evals/mistral-ops-14b-q2/2182000456/
eval-bot: new artifacts uploaded by Sam W: s3://redwood-evals/mistral-ops-14b-q2/2182000456/summary.json
Ravi P: I'll pull and run a diff on logits. If it's quant scale, differences should appear early in generation.
Sam W: blocker: need a quick CR from infra to allow dedicated GPU for a short replay run — current quota blocks the 8xA10 usage.
Luca G: pinged infra team in #eng-infra, cc @infra-bot. Also can run a smaller subset (10 prompts) locally while infra looks.
Aisha K: plan for today: run local-replay subset, attach logs; Ravi to run logits diff; Luca to check quant-table change history; Sam to prepare a minimal failing promptset for gating.
Sam W: thanks — will post progress. If we confirm it's quant regression, we might revert the micro-fix or add a compatibility mapping.
Luca G: quick note — if we gate on perf regression >3% we'll auto-block rollout. Is that still the threshold?
Aisha K: yes, 3% on held-out metric or >2% on core promptset triggers gate. Documented in runbook.
Sam W: ok, creating a short ticket and will add runbook links.
Aisha K: thanks. :thumbsup:
Ravi P: landing logs/initial diff by EOD PST.
Sam W: last: zero critical customer impact currently (staging only) — just trying to avoid CI surprises on canary.
Luca G: cool. ping if you need more GPUs.
